means: Ordering claims about repoScore that must hold in the LIVE index. Each is a judgement a person can argue with — that is the point: the ranking model is tuned against a written answer key, not against whichever number looks nicer this week. A pair fails when the live scores contradict it; a pair whose repos are missing is could-not-check, never a pass.

pairs.why: The SDK a stranger should be handed, versus a hackathon submission. This pair inverted on 2026-09-07 (76 vs 85) and is the reason the key exists.
The network's reference implementation must outrank a judged hackathon entry with no project link.
A live lending protocol on Stellar (21 stars) over a generic mnemonic tool with 4,314 stars and no Stellar code. Popularity elsewhere is not authority here.
The Soroban Rust SDK over a multi-chain wallet monorepo the scanner found no Stellar code in.
9,248 stars earned in a different ecosystem do not make a better Stellar reference.
A deployed AMM over a hackathon game, both Soroban, one with a product behind it.
